units.source_text: 不过，产品的价格嘛，如您所知，提到金、银或丝绸，掂掂分量就知道价值，这是了解门道的捷径。

en.t: But as for the price of goods, as you know, when it comes to gold, silver, or silk, weighing it tells you its value; that is the shortcut to understanding the trade.

units.source_text: 这条腰带是货真价实的，它的重量超过一百八十克。

en.t: This sash is the real thing, and it weighs more than one hundred eighty grams.

units.source_text: 就算是一百八十七点五克吧，光论其质地的价钱，也值六元九角七分。

en.t: Let us say it is one hundred eighty-seven point five grams; judging by the material alone, it is worth six yuan, nine jiao, and seven fen.

units.source_text: 就算七元吧，再加上加工费两元七角，还加上运费。

en.t: Call it seven yuan, then add two yuan and seven jiao for processing, plus the shipping cost.

units.source_text: 但是，胜田是许多东西一起加工的，这费用也给了特别的折扣。

en.t: But since Katsuta processes many items together, he has given a special discount on that cost as well.

units.source_text: 不论在哪儿做，这些东西都要花两元七角多呢，他只要一元七角左右就做成了。

en.t: Wherever you have these things made, they cost more than two yuan and seven jiao, but he can finish them for about one yuan and seven jiao.
Ah, it is basically the original cost.

units.source_text: 不过，这里要加上批发商的佣金、小商贩的回扣。

en.t: However, to this you must add the wholesaler's commission and the small dealer's cut.

units.source_text: 如果到店里去买的话，这种产品低于十二元无论如何是买不到手的。

en.t: If you went to a shop to buy one, there is no way you could get this kind of product for less than twelve yuan.

units.source_text: 这种货这里也有，这种飘逸的人造丝腰带也要八九元钱呢。

en.t: We have that sort of thing here too, and even these light, flowing rayon sashes cost eight or nine yuan.

units.source_text: 现在我来做个试验给大家看看，是纯粹的丝绸，请大家确认后再买。

en.t: Now I will perform a little test for everyone to see; it is pure silk, so please confirm it before you buy.

units.source_text: 这太便宜了，为什么这样便宜呢，我如果不做很长的说明，忽然谈价钱，也许诸位反而会产生怀疑呢。

en.t: This is far too cheap; why is it so cheap? If I suddenly named the price without giving a long explanation, you might become suspicious instead.

units.source_text: 说到四元，便宜得简直就像白给一样。

en.t: At four yuan, it is so cheap it is practically being given away.

units.source_text: 直到刚才，都是四元卖出去的。

en.t: Until just now, they were all being sold for four yuan.

units.source_text: 花四元买了的客人在场的话，请多多包涵。

en.t: If any customer here bought one for four yuan, please be generous and forgive me.
